review_candidates.title: Tier 2 Infrastructure & Network Engineer - Prince George, BC
review_candidates.description: About CORE Core Network Solutions Inc. is a Canadian managed IT services and network infrastructure company with more than 23 years of operation, serving over 150 clients across Western Canada from our head office in St. Albert, Alberta and our regional office in Prince George, British Columbia. We design, deploy and manage network, security and infrastructure environments for municipalities, health authorities and private-sector organizations — clients who expect their infrastructure to simply work, and who count on us when it doesn’t. Position Summary We are looking for a Tier 2 Infrastructure & Network Engineer to take a lead role in the design, deployment and ongoing operation of client network, virtualization and security environments. This is a hands-on senior role: you will own project delivery from design through cutover, act as the top escalation point for complex technical issues, and travel to client sites across Western Canada to deliver network implementations. The successful candidate is a broad, senior generalist — strong in enterprise networking, comfortable at a Linux command line, fluent in containerized and virtualized workloads, and confident configuring next-generation firewalls and web application firewalls. Key Responsibilities Network Implementation & Engineering •     Design, configure and deploy enterprise LAN, WAN, SD-WAN and wireless environments for client sites, including switching, routing, VLAN architecture and QoS. •     Lead network implementation projects end to end: requirements gathering, design documentation, bill of materials, staging and configuration, on-site installation, cutover and post-deployment validation. •     Configure and maintain routing and switching platforms across CORE’s core vendor lines, including Fortinet, Juniper, HPE, Arista and Check Point. •     Plan and execute network migrations and refreshes with minimal client disruption, including after-hours cutover windows. •     Implement and troubleshoot site-to-site and remote access VPN, including IPsec, IKEv2 and SSL VPN. •     Produce and maintain accurate network documentation: topology diagrams, IP schemas, configuration standards and as-built records. Linux Administration •     Deploy, harden, patch and administer Linux servers (Debian/Ubuntu and RHEL-family) in client and internal environments. •     Manage core Linux services including DNS, DHCP, NTP, SSH, web and reverse-proxy services, certificate management and log forwarding. •     Write and maintain shell scripts and lightweight automation to standardize repetitive administrative tasks. •     Perform Linux-level performance analysis and root cause investigation using standard diagnostic tooling. •     Apply security hardening baselines, manage user and privilege models, and support client audit and compliance requirements. Container & Docker Administration •     Deploy, configure and maintain Docker hosts and containerized workloads supporting client and internal services. •     Build and maintain container images, Docker Compose stacks, persistent storage and container networking. •     Monitor container health, resource consumption and logging; manage lifecycle, updates and image hygiene. •     Apply container security practices including image provenance, least-privilege runtime configuration and registry management. Cybersecurity — NGFW and WAF •     Deploy, configure and manage next-generation firewalls, including policy design, application control, IPS/IDS, URL filtering, TLS inspection and threat prevention profiles. •     Deploy and tune web application firewalls, including rule sets, policy exceptions, false-positive tuning and protection of published client applications. •     Implement network segmentation and zero-trust-aligned access policies across client environments. •     Support CORE’s CNSsecure security offerings and integrate deployed controls with client monitoring and reporting. •     Investigate security events, analyze firewall and system logs, and produce clear post-incident findings for clients. •     Stay current with emerging threats, vendor advisories and firmware and security patching cycles across managed platforms. Hypervisor Deployment & Management •     Design, deploy and manage virtualization platforms including Proxmox VE, Microsoft Hyper-V and Morpheus. •     Build and maintain clustered hypervisor environments including shared storage, high availability and live migration. •     Manage virtual machine lifecycle: provisioning, templating, resource allocation, snapshots and capacity planning. •     Configure virtual networking, distributed switching and hypervisor-level segmentation. •     Integrate virtualization platforms with backup and recovery tooling, and regularly validate restore capability. •     Perform hypervisor upgrades, patching and migrations between platforms. Project Travel & On-Site Delivery •     Travel to client sites across Alberta, British Columbia and Western Canada to deliver network and infrastructure implementations — approximately 25% of working time, typically in multi-day blocks scheduled in advance. •     Perform physical installation work: rack and stack, structured cabling termination and dressing, device mounting, labelling and equipment decommissioning. Troubleshooting & Analysis •     Serve as the senior escalation point for complex, cross-domain issues spanning network, server, virtualization and security layers. •     Apply a structured diagnostic method — reproduce, isolate the fault domain, test hypotheses, confirm root cause, remediate — rather than trial-and-error changes. •     Use packet capture and protocol analysis, log correlation and performance monitoring tooling to resolve issues others could not. •     Document root cause analyses and feed findings back into standards, monitoring and preventative maintenance. •     Mentor intermediate and junior technical staff in diagnostic technique and escalation discipline. Client Service & Managed Services Delivery •     Meet service level commitments and communicate proactively when timelines or scope change. •     Communicate directly with client technical and non-technical stakeholders •     Maintain client documentation to CORE standards •     Contribute to scoping, estimating and technical review of proposals and statements of work. •     Participate in the on-call rotation and after-hours maintenance windows as scheduled. Qualifications Required •     6–10+ years of progressive experience in network and infrastructure engineering, ideally including time with a managed services provider, VAR or multi-client consulting firm. •     Demonstrated experience leading network implementation projects end to end, on client sites. •     Strong hands-on enterprise routing and switching expertise, including VLANs, spanning tree, dynamic routing protocols and WAN/SD-WAN technologies. •     Solid Linux administration skills at the command line, including services, scripting, hardening and diagnostics. •     Practical Docker and container administration experience in a production context. •     Hands-on next-generation firewall experience — policy design, threat prevention, VPN and troubleshooting — plus working knowledge of web application firewalls. •     Hypervisor deployment and management experience with at least two of Proxmox VE, Hyper-V or Morpheus, and the capacity to become proficient in all three. •     Excellent troubleshooting and analytical ability across multiple technology layers. •     Strong written and verbal communication in English, including client-facing documentation. •     Valid Class 5 driver’s licence and a reliable vehicle for local and regional travel. •     Ability to pass criminal record and security clearance checks required by public-sector and health-sector clients. •     Legally entitled to work in Canada. Preferred •     Experience serving Canadian public-sector or health-sector clients (municipal, county, health authority). •     Familiarity with CORE’s primary vendor lines: Check Point, Fortinet, Juniper, HPE, Arista, Lenovo and Microsoft. •     Backup and disaster recovery experience, particularly where Canadian data residency is required. •     Infrastructure-as-code, configuration management or CI/CD exposure (Ansible, Terraform, Git-based workflows). •     Monitoring and observability tooling experience. •     Microsoft 365 and Entra ID / Active Directory administration. •     Experience mentoring or leading a small technical team. Certifications Certifications are valued, but demonstrated capability matters more. Any of the following are considered assets, and CORE supports certification pursuit for the right candidate. •     Security: Check Point CCSA / CCSE, Fortinet NSE 4–7, CompTIA Security+, SSCP •     Networking: Juniper JNCIA / JNCIS, JNCIP, JNCIE,Cisco CCNA / CCNP, CCIE, HPE Aruba ACSA / ACSP •     Linux: LPIC-1 / LPIC-2, Red Hat RHCSA / RHCE, CompTIA Linux+ •     Virtualization: Proxmox VE certification, Microsoft AZ-800 / AZ-801, VMware VCP •     Containers: Docker Certified Associate, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) Working Conditions •     Based at CORE’s Prince George, BC office, with a mix of office, client-site and remote work. •     Approximately 25% travel, primarily within Alberta and British Columbia, including occasional overnight and multi-day trips to rural and remote client sites. Travel is scheduled in advance wherever possible. •     Scheduled after-hours and weekend maintenance windows are a normal part of infrastructure cutover work. •     Participation in an on-call rotation. •     Physical requirements include lifting and positioning equipment up to approximately 50 lbs, working in server rooms and equipment closets. Core Network Solutions Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to providing accommodation for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process — please let us know if you require accommodation.

review_candidates.title: Infrastructure Engineer - Network & Systems
review_candidates.description: TriStarr Talent is seeking an Infrastructure Engineer to join a well-established financial institution in San Antonio to support the design, implementation, and ongoing reliability of its enterprise infrastructure. This is not a help-desk position. You will serve as a senior technical resource, working hands-on across networking, servers, virtualization, firewalls, storage, and backup/disaster recovery. The role combines complex Tier III troubleshooting with infrastructure projects that typically run from three to nine months. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced infrastructure professional who enjoys solving difficult problems, building reliable environments, and taking projects from initial requirements through implementation. What You’ll Do Install, configure, and support enterprise infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, servers, storage, and virtualization platforms. Support Cisco LAN switching and routing environments. Configure and troubleshoot enterprise firewall technologies. Administer VMware environments, including vSphere, ESXi, and vCenter. Support Windows and Linux servers in physical and virtual environments. Maintain enterprise storage, backup, recovery, and disaster-recovery solutions. Serve as a Tier III escalation resource for complex infrastructure incidents. Perform root-cause analysis and develop long-term solutions to recurring problems. Participate in infrastructure projects lasting approximately three to nine months. Gather technical requirements and contribute to solution design and implementation planning. Coordinate infrastructure changes with internal teams, vendors, and business stakeholders. Create and maintain network diagrams, implementation plans, support procedures, and technical documentation. Follow established security, change-management, and operational standards. Assist with infrastructure upgrades, migrations, refreshes, and disaster-recovery testing. What We’re Looking For 6+ years hands-on experience supporting enterprise IT infrastructure. Strong knowledge of Cisco LAN switching and routing. Experience configuring and troubleshooting enterprise firewalls. Hands-on VMware administration experience. Experience administering Windows Server environments. Working knowledge of Linux server administration. Experience supporting enterprise storage and backup technologies. Understanding of disaster recovery, system availability, and infrastructure resiliency. Proven ability to troubleshoot complex network and systems issues. Experience contributing to infrastructure design and implementation projects. Strong technical documentation, organization, and communication skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with technical teams and business stakeholders. Preferred Experience Previous experience in banking, financial services, healthcare, utilities, government, or another regulated environment. Experience with Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP. Experience with SAN or NAS storage. Experience with platforms such as Veeam, Rubrik, Commvault, or similar backup solutions. Cisco, VMware, Microsoft, firewall, storage, or backup certifications. Experience supporting highly available or business-critical infrastructure.

review_candidates.title: Systems Administrator
review_candidates.description: About the company Brio Water Technology, a Home Organizers, Inc. company, is a market leading water products brand that has helped millions stay hydrated through its unique and innovative product line. We offer full home water solutions designed to elevate the way people hydrate, combining sophisticated technology with modern, top tier design to deliver exceptional performance, customer satisfaction, and enhanced functionality. About the role We are seeking a Systems Administrator to join our IT team. Reporting to the Director of IT Operations, this role will spend approximately 90-95% of its time on broad, hands-on systems administration across Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, identity, endpoints, security tooling, SaaS and collaboration platforms, vendors, documentation, automation, and improvement projects. You will work alongside other Systems Administrators, Level 3 IT Analysts, and the Help Desk team. Brio Water and its IT organization are evolving quickly, and responsibilities, priorities, and processes will change over time. The remaining 5-10% of the role involves periodic networking, Azure Site Recovery, Azure and AWS services, public DNS, automated backups, and recovery testing. These are important responsibilities, but they are not the daily or full-time focus of the position. What you'll do Proactively identify operational risks and improvement opportunities, recommend practical solutions, and help implement platform rollouts, upgrades, migrations, integrations, office changes, and other approved initiatives. Administer Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, Teams, SharePoint, OneDrive, Google Workspace, and related identity, access, licensing, mailbox, group, and shared-resource functions. Administer endpoint management, patching, remote support, encryption, monitoring, EDR, and related security and operations tools across Windows and macOS devices; investigate alerts, failed automation, and recurring exceptions. Troubleshoot complex incidents involving authentication, permissions, mail flow, calendars, room systems, applications, endpoints, connectivity, SaaS platforms, and vendor integrations; identify root causes and turn repeat issues into durable fixes or runbooks. Use PowerShell and other appropriate automation to simplify recurring administration, reporting, deployment, validation, and cleanup while following practical testing, communication, documentation, and rollback practices . Periodic Infrastructure, Networking, and Recovery Responsibilities (Approximately 5-10%) Support and troubleshoot managed switches, firewalls, Wi-Fi, VLANs, routing, DHCP, internal DNS, site-to-site and client VPNs, segmentation, and multi-site connectivity, coordinating with vendors when appropriate. Maintain the small onsite server and storage footprint, review automated backup and replication alerts, resolve exceptions, and support periodic restores. Maintain Azure Site Recovery and assigned Azure, AWS, public DNS, domain, and certificate services, including replication health, recovery plans, documentation, test failovers, failback, and other approved recovery testing. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent practical experience, plus 4+ years of hands-on systems administration or infrastructure operations experience in a production business environment. Practical experience administering Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Entra ID, Active Directory, identities, permissions, licenses, mailboxes, groups, and shared resources. Experience administering endpoint management, patching, EDR or antivirus, encryption, monitoring, and remote support tools across Windows and macOS devices. Strong cross-system troubleshooting skills and experience implementing technology changes, coordinating vendors, validating results, and documenting completed work. Demonstrated networking fundamentals and practical troubleshooting experience with TCP/IP, managed switches, VLAN tagging and trunk ports, routing, firewalls, VPNs, Wi-Fi, DNS, and DHCP. Familiarity with Azure administration and Azure Site Recovery or a comparable recovery platform, along with working knowledge of AWS, public DNS, certificates, automated backup and restore processes, and basic recovery testing. Working PowerShell skills, clear communication, practical documentation habits, sound judgment, and comfort operating in an evolving organization with changing priorities and responsibilities. Preferred Qualifications Direct experience with Azure Site Recovery, Recovery Services vaults, replication policies, recovery plans, test failovers, and failback. Hands-on Cisco or Fortinet experience and experience supporting managed networks or infrastructure across multiple sites. Experience with Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace coexistence; endpoint, security, or monitoring tools such as CrowdStrike, Datadog, NinjaOne, or PDQ; or relevant Azure or AWS certifications. Benefits / Perks We believe in recognizing and rewarding our employees for a job well done. We offer growth potential for motivated individuals, competitive compensation, and a comprehensive benefits package, including: Medical, Dental, Vision, Life Insurance 401K Retirement Plan Paid Vacation Time Paid Holidays and More!

With over 780 employees, including more than 585 dedicated cybersecurity professionals, Integrity360 delivers a full suite of professional, support, and managed security services. These span the complete cyber risk lifecycle, from identification and prevention to detection, response, and recovery. Integrity360 supports over 3000 mid-market and enterprise organisations across sectors including financial services, insurance, government, healthcare, retail, telecommunications, and utilities. Integrity360's Calgary office serves as the hub for our Canadian operations, providing professional services, managed security services, and cybersecurity consulting to clients across Western Canada and beyond. In addition to the six SOCs mentioned above, the 7th SOC will be opening soon in Calgary. At Integrity360, people come first. We invest heavily in learning, development and progression, fostering a dynamic culture where innovation, collaboration and continuous growth are at the heart of what we do. If you're ready to take your cyber security career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you. Job Role / Responsibilities The successful candidate will be part of a dynamic support and managed service team working on multi-vendor environments. The team is the first point of contact offering remote technical support and managed services for a large client base. Skills The successful candidate will have excellent analytical skills, and will be encouraged to work on their own initiative as well as be an integral part of a dynamic team. This role requires you to grow in a team of Support engineers with various levels of experience and to excel in the following key areas: Client Experience: Provide a professional, responsive, and customer-focused experience for managed services and support clients. Maintain clear communication throughout the request lifecycle, set appropriate expectations, and ensure clients receive timely updates. Network Security & Firewall Administration Fundamentals: Maintain a foundational understanding of networking and firewall technologies (Primarily PAN NGFW) to effectively perform Level 1 triage, troubleshooting, and operational support activities. Service Desk Operations: Operate within established service desk processes, including ticket intake, validation, prioritization, documentation, escalation, and closure. Ensure incidents, requests, and changes are accurately recorded and managed in accordance with company standards and service level objectives. Workload Planning & Management: Proactively manage individual workload, client commitments, and operational responsibilities to ensure work is delivered effectively and on time. Maintain an accurate calendar, track action items and follow-ups, manage competing priorities, and regularly reassess workload based on changing business and client needs. Vendor Escalation & Coordination: Engage with security technology partners for enhanced issue resolution and escalation. On-Call Support: Participate in after-hours response rotation to ensure continuous security coverage. Technical Experience Strong understanding of TCP/IP networking fundamentals, including IP addressing, subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, DNS, DHCP, NAT, and packet flow analysis. Ability to troubleshoot network connectivity issues and determine whether problems are related to routing, firewall policy, NAT, VPN connectivity, DNS, application behavior, or external systems. Understanding of enterprise firewall concepts, including security zones, policy evaluation, source/destination matching, applications, services, address objects, and NAT policies. Ability to analyze firewall logs and traffic logs to determine policy matches, identify blocked traffic, validate expected behavior, and support incident investigation. Experience using troubleshooting and packet analysis tools such as Wireshark to validate traffic flows and support root cause analysis. Experience performing firewall administration activities, including policy implementation, rule modifications, object management, NAT configuration, policy cleanup, and log analysis. Experience supporting firewall software upgrades and maintenance activities in enterprise environments, including upgrade planning, pre/post-change validation, maintenance window execution, and change verification. Familiarity with Palo Alto Networks NGFW technologies, including Security Policies, NAT Policies, Security Zones, App-ID, User-ID, Logging, Objects, Panorama, and Threat Prevention. Exposure to enterprise firewall platforms such as Palo Alto Networks, Fortinet, Check Point, Cisco, or similar security technologies. Basic scripting, automation, or API experience is considered an asset. Qualification A degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Security, or a related discipline is preferred; however, it is not a requirement. Candidates with a minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience in a similar role will be given equal consideration. Knowledge of network infrastructure, including routers, switches, firewalls, and the associated network protocols and concepts. Industry certification is an advantage in one or more of the following: Palo Alto Networks: Network Security Analyst, Next-Generation Firewall Engineer, Network Security Professional, or equivalent Palo Alto certification. Fortinet: FCP (Fortinet Certified Professional), FCSS (Fortinet Certified Solution Specialist), or equivalent Fortinet network security certification.

review_candidates.title: Senior Network Engineer
review_candidates.description: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase. As an Infrastructure Lead on the Exchange team within Institutional, you'll own the network infrastructure, deployment, and operational tooling behind a unified trading platform that runs across cloud and on-prem/colocated venues. This team powers the systems that let the world's largest financial institutions trade across markets with speed, depth, and trust. You'll keep latency-sensitive, multi-node trading environments fast, reliable, and easy to build on, shaping trading infrastructure from the ground up with the ownership of a startup and the reach of Coinbase. What you'll do: Own, operate, and optimize resilient, ultra-low-latency networks and physical data-center infrastructure supporting institutional trading, market data, and exchange connectivity across cloud and on-prem environments, including racking, cabling, cross-connects, and vendor coordination. Design and maintain routing, traffic-segmentation, and multicast market-data architectures using BGP, OSPF, VRFs, PIM, IGMP, and high-availability platforms such as Arista MLAG, Cisco vPC, and VRRP. Deploy and operate firewalls and secure connectivity across Fortinet and Palo Alto platforms, including IPsec VPNs, SSL VPNs, and third-party connections. Drive observability and operational excellence through SNMP, gRPC telemetry, latency and packet-loss analysis, microburst detection, and network automation using Python, Ansible, or similar tools. Lead safe production changes, incident response, failover testing, and out-of-hours maintenance for 24/7 trading systems, and participate in an on-call rotation. Mentor engineers and partner cross-functionally with SRE/Infra, Product, and trading-system teams to improve reliability, reduce single-point-of-failure risk, and increase developer velocity. Required Skills and Experience: 8+ years of network, infrastructure, or SRE engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of production systems in financial services, electronic trading, or another latency-sensitive environment, including on-prem/colocated deployments. Deep hands-on expertise with multicast networking, BGP, OSPF, VRFs, high-availability architectures, low-latency data-center switching, and physical network infrastructure. Proven ability to lead live incident response for production trading systems, manage risk during changes, and coordinate cross-functional resolution during market events. Experience with Fortinet or Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, SNMP or gRPC telemetry, network automation using Python or Ansible, and strong Linux networking fundamentals in latency-critical environments. Familiarity with exchange or electronic trading system concepts; deep crypto experience is a plus, not a requirement. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality. Pay Transparency Notice: Base salary varies by location (see range below). Total compensation may also include equity and bonus eligibility, and benefits (medical, dental, vision, 401(k)). Annual base salary range (excluding equity and bonus):: $186,065 USD - $218,900 USD Application Limit: Candidates may submit a maximum of 3 applications within a 6-month period. Equal Opportunity Employer: Coinbase is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or genetic information. Applicants with criminal histories will be considered consistent with applicable federal, state, and local laws. US Applicants: View Employee Rights, Know Your Rights, and E-Verify Notice of Participation. Accommodations: If you are an individual with a disability who needs a reasonable accommodation, email us your request and contact info at accommodations[at]coinbase.com. Need screen reading technology? Click here to download a free compatible screen reader and view the tutorial. Data Privacy & Arbitration: By submitting your application, you agree to our Candidate Privacy Notice. US applicants: By submitting your application, you agree to Arbitration of Disputes.

review_candidates.title: IT Network Specialist
review_candidates.description: About Allia Health Group Allia Health Group is a fast-growing digital health system revolutionizing metabolic, hormonal, and longevity care. As the parent organization behind Brello Health (women's telehealth and longevity programs), HelloWellness (men's telehealth), Southend Pharmacy (a state-licensed 503A compounding pharmacy), and Zito Care (our healthcare provider network), we deliver seamless, end-to-end care powered by a shared technology and AI platform. We remove barriers so clinicians can focus on patients and patients can access personalized, proactive care on their own terms — whether through telehealth visits, compounded medications, lab testing, wellness support, and more, all in one connected experience across 35+ states. Allia is building the future of healthcare by being clinician-first and patient-centered. We are innovative, empathetic, and accessible to our patients, combining cutting-edge tools with human-centered care to make high-quality longevity and wellness solutions affordable and available to more people. Why join us? At Allia Health Group, you're part of something bigger — helping shape a mission-driven enterprise that's scaling rapidly, solving real problems in healthcare inefficiencies, and making a tangible difference in people's lives every day. Position Summary Own the on-premise network and its security at the Southend Pharmacy compounding facility and across the infrastructure supporting our brands, working with the CTO organization’s cloud security team where site infrastructure meets cloud workloads. Beyond keeping things connected, this role builds the logging, alerting, and monitoring layer that lets us see security and availability events, which is our biggest blind spot today. Escalation and change approval run through the IT Operations Lead. Identity-integrated network access is coordinated with the Systems Administrator. Key Responsibilities Network Segmentation: Design and maintain zones that separate compounding production systems, PHI-bearing workstations, clinical devices, administrative users, and guest or BYOD traffic, which the 2026 HIPAA Security Rule expects. Firewall & Perimeter Management: Own the firewall rule lifecycle, including documented periodic review, change approval, and elimination of undocumented or overly permissive rules. Logging Architecture: Deploy and operate centralized log collection spanning firewalls, switches, wireless, servers, endpoints, and pharmacy production systems, with retention configured to the standard set by the compliance program. Alerting & Detection: Build tuned alert rules with clear severity tiers routed to a named responder. The goal is a manageable number of alerts that are worth acting on. Proactive Monitoring: Track throughput, latency, packet loss, and capacity on production-critical paths, watching trends so problems surface before they turn into outages. Site Connectivity & Redundancy: Manage carrier circuits and redundant paths for the pharmacy and supporting sites, and test failover on a schedule so we know it works. Wireless Infrastructure: Deploy enterprise wireless with certificate-based authentication and separate production, corporate, and guest SSIDs, tuned for the density of scanners and mobile devices on the production floor. Secure Remote Access: Administer VPN and Zero Trust network access for remote staff and offshore contractors, in coordination with the Systems Administrator (Identity & IAM). Vulnerability Management: Run regular scans of network-attached infrastructure and track fixes to closure, documenting risk acceptance where a fix is deferred. Technical Incident Response: Lead the technical side of security incidents, covering detection, triage, containment, eradication, and the write-up afterward. Pre-Authorized Containment: Act immediately on lower-severity events such as isolating an endpoint, disabling an account, or blocking an address, and notify afterward. Escalate to the IT Operations Lead when there is suspected PHI exposure, when an action would affect compounding production, or when an incident stays open past its severity clock. Configuration & Change Control: Version all network configurations, keep topology documentation current, and produce evidence supporting SOC 2 change-management controls. Circuit & Vendor Governance: Hold carriers and hardware vendors accountable to contracted service levels, and plan end-of-life refresh before equipment becomes an availability risk. Site Coverage Backup: Provide on-site coverage for the IT Support Specialist during absences or overlapping production incidents, following documented runbook procedures only. This role does not own tickets or work the standard support queue. Coverage: Standard hours are 08:00 to 17:00 CST, Monday through Friday, with participation in an on-call rotation for production-critical and security events outside those hours. IT Network Specialist — Qualifications Education Bachelor's degree in information technology, computer science, network engineering, or a related field preferred. Equivalent hands-on experience is accepted in place of a degree. Required Certifications CCNA, or equivalent vendor certification for comparable platforms (JNCIA, Aruba ACSA, Fortinet FCP), or demonstrated equivalent skill CompTIA Security+, or equivalent security fundamentals credential Preferred Certifications Firewall certification for Palo Alto PCNSA/PCNSE, Fortinet NSE, Cisco Firepower CWNA (Certified Wireless Network Administrator) Cisco CyberOps Associate, GIAC GCIH, or comparable incident response training Required Experience 5-8 years in network administration or network engineering At least 2 years owning a production network environment, including change decisions and escalation, rather than working assigned tickets within someone else's design Multi-site experience including carrier circuit management and redundant path failover Direct, hands-on firewall rule administration — creating, reviewing, and removing rules under a change process Enterprise wireless deployment and troubleshooting Strongly Preferred Experience Built centralized logging, monitoring, or SIEM capability from the ground up, including choosing what to collect, configuring retention, and tuning alerts. This is the highest-value qualification for this role. Network segmentation in a regulated or production environment — healthcare, pharmaceutical, manufacturing, or PCI-scoped Wireless deployment supporting handheld scanners or mobile equipment in a warehouse, production floor, or clinical setting Participation in security incident response, including containment and post-incident documentation Producing evidence for compliance audits (HIPAA, SOC 2, PCI, HITRUST) Trainable — Not Required HIPAA and SOC 2 specifics, pharmacy operations, and USP 797/800 controlled-area procedures. Candidates with PCI, clinical, or manufacturing OT backgrounds carry transferable instincts and should not be screened out for lacking healthcare experience. What We Offer: Full benefits package including medical, vision, dental, 401(k) with company match, PTO, Flex days, holidays, and more! Allia Health Group does not provide employment visa sponsorship now or in the future. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future sponsorship. We are committed to cultivating a culture where all team members feel valued & respected. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetic information, disability, age, veteran status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.

review_candidates.title: Associate Product Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Who We Are: SIOS Technology is helping companies protect their most important applications from downtime and disasters. Come join our team and work with the world’s leading experts in application high availability and disaster recovery. We operate globally, recognize and reward talent, and work hard to keep SIOS a great place to work. SIOS is headquartered in San Mateo, CA, with offices across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific. Our Columbia, SC office, located at the University of South Carolina Innovation Center, was recognized as one of the state’s best places to work in SC for the past 7 consecutive years.  What We Believe in: At SIOS Technology Corp., we believe our greatest strength is our ability to grow, collaborate, and innovate with a diverse team of employees in a positive, inclusive environment. The rich contributions that SIOS employees around the world make to our team are informed and enhanced by their individual differences, life experiences, traditions, values, and talents. We are committed to nurturing a culture of inclusion and connectedness among team members from different races, ethnicities, nationalities, religions, beliefs, genders, sexual orientations, ages, and disabilities. Position Overview: SIOS Technology Corp. is seeking a talented and enthusiastic Associate Product Support Engineer to join our fast-paced and fun Customer Experience Team located on the University of South Carolina campus (Columbia, SC). The Associate Product Support Engineer is the first line of contact for customers experiencing issues with installation, configuration, operation, and management of the SIOS solution. As an Associate Product Support Engineer, you will be part of a 7x24 Support Team focused on worldwide customer support for the SIOS family of high availability clustering and continuous data protection products. You will be responsible for providing phone and email support to end customers, resellers, system integrators, and partners for the industry’s best solution for ensuring uptime of business-critical applications. Reporting to the Director, Product Support Engineering, this position requires the ability to work remotely and participate in an After-Hours Pager rotation. What you will be doing: Provide day-to-day support to customers with valid support contracts to ensure that customer expectations are exceeded Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve issues reported Track issues using the provided support tools Own and manage issues through resolution, working with Engineering, Sales, and Product Management as necessary Ensure support service levels are met or exceeded  Validate that customers have current support contracts Join  After Hours support rotation Provide all levels of support and escalate to Engineering when necessary Work with Support and/or Product Development to troubleshoot and workaround product issues Create enhancement requests and product change requests when reported by customers Prioritize time and support cases What you will bring: Practical knowledge of Cloud Deployments (such as AWS/Azure/GCP)  Basic knowledge of Hypervisor technologies (such as VMware, Hyper-V, VirtualBox, OpenShift) Practical experience with Operating Systems Basic Knowledge of scripting languages (Perl / Bash / Python / JavaScript) Proficient with Collaboration Tools Zoom WebEx GoToMeeting Google Meets FaceTime Proficient with Microsoft Office Proficient with Google Suite Applications (Gmail, Calendar, Drive) Preferred Skills: Hands-on experience with Linux / Windows Operating Systems Hands-on experience with virtualization technologies Practical knowledge of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems  SalesForce (SFDC) ZenDesk  Proficient in prompt engineering, AI research and notetaking, and other advanced AI tools  Education/Experience Requirements: Associate’s Degree or higher in Computer Science or related field. At least 1-2 years of professional experience in Technical Customer Support What we offer: Attractive compensation package Group Bonus  Incentive Stock Option Full suite of benefits  Remote-first work arrangement Flexible working environment Unlimited Time Off 12 Paid Company Holidays What else should you know about this position? The R&D office is located in Columbia, SC, on the campus of the University of South Carolina (Innovation Center). You are more than welcome to work out of our office as much as you want or work from the comfort of your own home office; whatever works best for you. However, if you live in the surrounding area of Columbia, SC, we expect you to come to the office once a week. If you are working remotely, we expect you to come to a team/company event at the Columbia office no more than once a month. We prefer candidates who live in SC or the surrounding states of SC but we are open to other states in the Eastern or Central time zones. We believe promoting inclusive work culture starts with the hiring process. As such, you will meet different levels of employees throughout the interview process. Our hope is that by the end of the interview process, you will get to meet the whole team and have a good understanding of our culture. Here is our typical hiring process. Phone or zoom screening with a hiring manager. Technical Interviews   Behavioral / Cultural interviews with cross-functional team members, including some leadership team members.

Correlate events using Netscout, Mantaray, and PM/CM data. Troubleshoot and resolve complex issues related to registration, session management, mobility, policy, charging, DNS, IPSec and Handover issues. Handle node-level failures (AMF/SMF/UPF/NRF/UDM/UDR/SDL/PCF/CHF/Flowone/HSM/NCOM, NetAct Nokia EDR restarts, crashes, overload). Handle troubleshooting on 5G Core Database, UDM, UDR, SDL, Provisioning, Flowone, CHF(Charging), PCF(Policy). Perform root cause analysis (RCA) , create RCA documents and implement corrective actions. Handle escalations support and provide timely resolution. Maintain accurate shift handovers, operational reports, knowledge articles and recurring-issue records. Identify opportunities for playbook improvement and operational automation while following security and change controls. Session & Service Investigation: Trace subscriber issues (5G attach, PDU session, QoS). Use tools like EDR, Flow Tracer, Nokia Cloud Operations Manager (COM). Correlate user-plane drops, abnormal release, bearer QoS mismatch. Work on Preventive measures for health check & backup. Configuration and Change Management: Create a MOP for required changes, validate MOP with Ops teams, stakeholders before rollout/implementation. Maintain detailed documentation of network configurations, incident reports, and operational procedures. Support software upgrades, patch management, and configuration changes. Maintain documentation for known issues, troubleshooting guides, and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Ability to execute approved MOPs, assess pre/post checks, maintain accurate records and communicate service impact clearly. Support integration of new 5G Core nodes and features into the live network. Performance Monitoring: Use KPI dashboards (NetAct/NetScout) to monitor 5G Core KPIs e.g registration success rate, PDU session setup success, latency, throughput, user-plane utilization. Proactively detect degrading KPIs trends. Security & Access Support: Application support for Nokia EDR and CrowdStrike. Assist with certificate renewal, firewall/NAT issues, and access failures. Escalation & Coordination: Escalate unresolved issues to L3 teams, TAC, OSS/Core engineering. Work with L3 and care team for issue resolution. Ensure compliance with SLAs and contribute to continuous service improvement. Reporting Generate daily/weekly/monthly reports on network performance, incident trends, and SLA compliance. Professional & Technical Skills: 8–12 years of experience in Telecom industry with hands on experience in 5G Core. Mandatory experience with Nokia 5G Core-SA platform. Experience in fault management, KPI analysis, incident restoration, log/trace collection and escalation management. Working knowledge of CNFs, containers, Kubernetes/EKS concepts, microservices and cloud observability Solid understanding for 5G Core Packet Core Network Protocol such as N1, N2, N3, N6, N7, N8, 5G Core interfaces, GTP-C/U, HTTPS and including ability to trace, debug the issues. Hands-on experience with 5GC components: AMF, SMF, UPF, NRF, AUSF, NSSF, UDM, PCF, CHF, UDR, SDL, NCOM, NetAct, HSM, Nokia EDR, Provisioning and Flowone. Troubleshooting and configuration hands on experience on 5G Core Database, UDM, UDR, SDL, Provisioning, Flowone, CHF(Charging), PCF(Policy). In-depth understanding of 3GPP call flows for 5G-SA, 5G NSA, Call routing, number analysis, system configuration, call flow, Data roaming, configuration and knowledge of Telecom standards e.g. 3GPP, ITU-T and ANSI. Familiarity with policy control mechanisms, QoS enforcement, and charging models (event-based, session-based). Hands-on experience with Diameter, HTTP/2, REST APIs, and SBI interfaces. Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Proficiency in monitoring and tracing tools (NetAct, NetScout, PCMD tracing). And log management systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana), AWS CoudWatch, ServiceNow. Knowledge of network protocols and security (TLS, IPsec). Experience with ServiceNow incident/change workflows and ITIL-aligned Incident, Problem and Change Management. review_candidates.description: Network & Wireless Engineer – Project Delivery VALL Technologies | Fort Collins, Colorado Full-Time | On-Site / Field-Based About the Role VALL Technologies is seeking a Network & Wireless Engineer who enjoys solving technical problems, working directly with customers, and taking ownership of projects from preparation through successful completion. This is not a narrowly defined network operations position. Our projects span enterprise networking, Wi-Fi, private wireless, fixed wireless, switching, routing, firewalls, and other communications infrastructure. Because we are a small engineering company, the person in this role will have meaningful responsibility and will work across engineering, deployment, troubleshooting, project coordination, and customer communication. We are looking for someone who takes pride in being dependable, prepared, technically capable, and easy to work with. You should enjoy learning unfamiliar technologies and be comfortable saying, “I haven’t worked with that before, but I’ll figure it out.” What You’ll Do You will help design, stage, configure, deploy, troubleshoot, and support customer networks. Typical responsibilities include: Configure and provision enterprise Wi-Fi access points, switches, routers, and firewalls Stage and validate equipment before customer deployments Configure and troubleshoot Ruckus wireless and ICX switching platforms Install and commission network hardware and software Troubleshoot Layer 1 through Layer 3 network issues Perform wireless troubleshooting and basic RF analysis Assist with Wi-Fi surveys, validation, optimization, and performance testing Work with VLANs, DHCP, routing, switching, PoE, VPNs, firewalls, and related network services Maintain accurate configurations, documentation, inventories, and project records Coordinate project activities and track open items through resolution Communicate directly with customers, vendors, manufacturers, and project partners Provide concise project updates identifying completed work, open items, roadblocks, and next steps Follow up proactively rather than waiting to be asked for status Travel to customer locations when projects require onsite engineering or deployment support Our work occasionally requires early mornings, evenings, maintenance windows, or longer days during deployments and critical customer events. These are not intended to be the everyday schedule, but flexibility is an important part of the position. What We’re Looking For Technical capability matters, but reliability and ownership matter just as much. The right person: Shows up on time and prepared Communicates clearly and professionally Takes ownership of assignments through completion Keeps customers and teammates informed without being chased for updates Identifies roadblocks early and asks for help when necessary Can organize multiple projects and priorities Pays attention to details Documents their work Enjoys troubleshooting difficult technical problems Is comfortable interacting directly with customers Maintains a friendly, professional demeanor, including when projects become stressful Is willing to perform both engineering and hands-on implementation work Is curious and willing to learn technologies outside their existing experience Technical Experience Strong candidates should have experience with several of the following: Enterprise Wi-Fi Ruckus Wireless or comparable enterprise WLAN platforms Ruckus ICX, Cisco, Aruba, Juniper, or comparable Ethernet switching VLANs and 802.1Q trunking Layer 2 switching and spanning tree IPv4 networking and subnetting Static and dynamic routing DHCP and DNS Firewalls, NAT, and VPNs PoE/PoE+/PoE++ Network troubleshooting using packet captures, CLI tools, and diagnostic utilities Wireless RF fundamentals including RSSI, SNR, channel utilization, interference, channel planning, and transmit power Network equipment staging, installation, testing, and commissioning Experience with CBRS/private LTE/5G, fixed wireless, microwave, fiber networks, RF design tools, or spectrum analysis is a plus but is not required. We would rather hire someone with strong fundamentals, initiative, and the ability to learn than someone who simply has a long list of certifications. Project & Customer Responsibility This is an important part of the position. Engineers at VALL Technologies interact directly with customers. You will be expected to understand what you are responsible for, know the status of your projects, communicate changes and roadblocks, and follow commitments through completion. If you prefer a position where someone else handles customers, schedules, project coordination, and follow-up while you concentrate exclusively on network configuration, this position probably isn’t the right fit. If you enjoy owning a technical problem and helping a customer get from “we have a problem” to “it’s working,” you may enjoy this role. Physical & Travel Requirements This position includes hands-on network deployment work. Candidates must be comfortable: Installing and replacing network equipment Working in equipment rooms, telecom closets, offices, and customer facilities Using basic hand tools Moving and installing typical networking equipment Traveling periodically for customer projects Occasionally working from ladders or at modest heights when necessary VALL Technologies does not operate a bucket truck, and tower or significant work-at-height activities are generally performed by specialized contractors. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer at VALL Technologies becomes someone our customers and team can depend on. When assigned a project, you understand the objective, prepare for the work, execute it professionally, communicate what happened, identify anything still outstanding, and make sure the project continues moving forward. You don’t need to know everything on your first day. You do need to care about getting things right. About VALL Technologies VALL Technologies is a Colorado-based wireless and network engineering company serving enterprise, municipal, education, hospitality, telecommunications, and other customers. We work across traditional IT networking and advanced wireless infrastructure, giving our engineers exposure to projects and technologies that are difficult to experience in a narrowly specialized networking position. We are a small company. That means individual performance matters, good work is visible, and engineers have an opportunity to take significant responsibility as their capabilities grow.

review_candidates.description: The Selkirk Cogeneration Station is a 446 MW natural gas-fired facility in Selkirk, New York, featuring three GE 7EA combustion turbines, one steam turbine, and four auxiliary boilers. Owned by Gate City Capital and operated by NAES Corporation, the plant provides reliable combined heat and power generation. New Athens Generating, located 30 miles south of Albany, is a 1,080 MW combined-cycle facility featuring three Siemens 501G combustion turbines. Opportunity Summary The Plant Engineer provides engineering, reliability, and technical support for Selkirk Cogeneration Station and New Athens Generating, helping improve plant performance, equipment reliability, and operational efficiency. Based at Selkirk, this role also leads the facility’s NERC compliance program, overseeing regulatory requirements, internal controls, documentation, and audit readiness. This position offers a unique opportunity to combine hands-on power generation engineering with significant NERC compliance leadership across two natural gas-fired generating facilities. As Plant Engineer, you will play a key role in the following areas: Engineering Performance & Reliability – Selkirk & New Athens Monitor plant equipment and performance, including combustion turbines, steam turbines, HRSGs, and auxiliary systems, analyzing heat rate, efficiency, and operating trends to improve reliability and performance. Investigate forced outages, generation losses, equipment failures, and operational events; perform root cause analyses and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence. Evaluate and optimize DCS, PLC, instrumentation, and measurement systems to support reliable equipment operation and accurate plant performance data. Support predictive and condition-based maintenance programs, including vibration analysis, thermography, and oil analysis, to identify equipment issues and improve reliability. Develop and maintain engineering procedures, drawings, technical specifications, and configuration documentation to ensure accurate plant records and effective configuration control. Coordinate with plant personnel, OEMs, engineering firms, and contractors to troubleshoot technical issues, implement equipment modifications, and develop scopes of work. Perform equipment reliability studies and design reviews, recommending improvements that increase availability, efficiency, capacity, and long-term plant performance. Manage capital and engineering projects from development through implementation, ensuring adherence to approved budgets, schedules, and contractual requirements. Provide engineering and technical support to Selkirk Cogeneration Station and New Athens Generating for plant performance, reliability, troubleshooting, and project needs. NERC Compliance & Program Administration – Selkirk Serve as Selkirk’s primary site lead for NERC compliance, overseeing applicable Operator and Owner compliance obligations and maintaining ongoing regulatory readiness. Manage Selkirk’s NERC Internal Control Program (ICP), including procedures, internal controls, compliance evidence, records, and required documentation. Monitor and interpret applicable NERC Reliability Standards and regulatory changes, assessing plant impacts and implementing necessary updates to programs, procedures, and controls. Manage NERC compliance documentation and reporting, including RSAWs, evidence packages, self-certifications, and other required records. Lead preparation for NERC audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory visits in coordination with NAES NERC personnel and other internal and external stakeholders. Identify compliance risks and gaps, manage corrective actions through completion, and maintain processes for tracking requirements, deadlines, and compliance responsibilities. Develop NERC compliance training and advise plant personnel and leadership on Reliability Standards, regulatory changes, compliance risks, and required actions. NAES Safe Safety is a core value at NAES, and as a condition of employment, all employees are expected to remain mentally alert and work safely at all times. Employees must also adhere to all safety warnings and posted signs while on company property. Additionally, they are required to follow all NAES safety rules and procedures. Adherence to these safety responsibilities is one of the key factors in the evaluation of each employee’s performance. Working Relationships The Plant Engineer reports to the Plant Manager and collaborates with plant leadership, Operations, Maintenance, and NAES Corporate resources on engineering, reliability, and NERC compliance activities. Physical Requirements And Working Conditions Physical requirements include standing for extended periods of time, climbing stairs and ladders, working from elevated platforms and walkways at varying heights, and routinely lifting up to 50 pounds. Power plant environment that may involve entering confined spaces, crawling through narrow areas, and handling hazardous materials, with exposure to fumes, extreme temperatures, and noise. Work may include high heat near equipment and varying outdoor weather conditions. Some duties may require the use of protective equipment, which can include hard hats, safety glasses, and eye protection, air masks/respirators, ear protection, chemical suits, flame-resistant clothing (FRC), hot gloves, high-voltage protective gear, and fall protection. Fit testing for respirators may be required. Strict smoking restrictions apply in and around the facility. review_candidates.description: Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration , enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide , including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences. About The Role As a Backend Software Engineer on the Data Layer team, you'll help build and evolve the storage and query layer that keeps Camunda 8's process data fast, accurate, and available at scale. Spanning both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, the data layer and its data pipelines power everything from process monitoring to the new agent-driven automation capabilities we're rolling out. As part of the Data Layer team, you will work on both technically challenging and rewarding projects, such as reshaping how we store and retain process data, streaming data to external systems, and evolving our secondary storage systems to perform at ever greater scale. At Camunda, we approach engineering in a holistic manner. As such, you will form strong partnerships with product management, design, QA, and support, and work with your peers to not only deliver but directly influence how our data layer evolves to meet our customers' needs. Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Own the end-to-end delivery of engineering initiatives, working with Product Management and senior colleagues to break down requirements into concrete solution designs, driving projects to timely and high-quality delivery. Help evolve how we process, retain, and expose process data, so customers can work with their data the way they need to. Invest in making our secondary storage systems more performant and scalable as usage grows, and build tooling that makes it easier to understand, troubleshoot, and safely operate the data layer in production. Participate in L3 support and on-call rotations, partnering with Support and SRE to investigate data layer production issues, and feeding what you learn back into the product. What You Bring Ability and/or willingness to use our product At least 4 years of experience as a backend engineer, with a strong focus on backend systems and production data stores Hands-on experience with at least one of PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB, MSSQL, or Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, with a practical understanding of query performance, indexing, and data modeling trade-offs Experience contributing to complex engineering initiatives: breaking down requirements into concrete tasks, writing clear technical designs for your piece of the work, and delivering reliably Comfortable investigating slow queries, execution plans, and index usage to root-cause data-related production issues. Strong communication and collaboration skills in a remote-first environment: you translate requirements into actionable technical work with Product, and give and receive clear, direct feedback in code review. Nice-to-haves Experience building workflow automation or process orchestration software. Experience working with both relational databases and Elasticsearch/OpenSearch. new_matches.title: Tier 2 Infrastructure & Network Engineer - Prince George, BC
new_matches.description: About CORE Core Network Solutions Inc. is a Canadian managed IT services and network infrastructure company with more than 23 years of operation, serving over 150 clients across Western Canada from our head office in St. Albert, Alberta and our regional office in Prince George, British Columbia. We design, deploy and manage network, security and infrastructure environments for municipalities, health authorities and private-sector organizations — clients who expect their infrastructure to simply work, and who count on us when it doesn’t. Position Summary We are looking for a Tier 2 Infrastructure & Network Engineer to take a lead role in the design, deployment and ongoing operation of client network, virtualization and security environments. This is a hands-on senior role: you will own project delivery from design through cutover, act as the top escalation point for complex technical issues, and travel to client sites across Western Canada to deliver network implementations. The successful candidate is a broad, senior generalist — strong in enterprise networking, comfortable at a Linux command line, fluent in containerized and virtualized workloads, and confident configuring next-generation firewalls and web application firewalls. Key Responsibilities Network Implementation & Engineering •     Design, configure and deploy enterprise LAN, WAN, SD-WAN and wireless environments for client sites, including switching, routing, VLAN architecture and QoS. •     Lead network implementation projects end to end: requirements gathering, design documentation, bill of materials, staging and configuration, on-site installation, cutover and post-deployment validation. •     Configure and maintain routing and switching platforms across CORE’s core vendor lines, including Fortinet, Juniper, HPE, Arista and Check Point. •     Plan and execute network migrations and refreshes with minimal client disruption, including after-hours cutover windows. •     Implement and troubleshoot site-to-site and remote access VPN, including IPsec, IKEv2 and SSL VPN. •     Produce and maintain accurate network documentation: topology diagrams, IP schemas, configuration standards and as-built records. Linux Administration •     Deploy, harden, patch and administer Linux servers (Debian/Ubuntu and RHEL-family) in client and internal environments. •     Manage core Linux services including DNS, DHCP, NTP, SSH, web and reverse-proxy services, certificate management and log forwarding. •     Write and maintain shell scripts and lightweight automation to standardize repetitive administrative tasks. •     Perform Linux-level performance analysis and root cause investigation using standard diagnostic tooling. •     Apply security hardening baselines, manage user and privilege models, and support client audit and compliance requirements. Container & Docker Administration •     Deploy, configure and maintain Docker hosts and containerized workloads supporting client and internal services. •     Build and maintain container images, Docker Compose stacks, persistent storage and container networking. •     Monitor container health, resource consumption and logging; manage lifecycle, updates and image hygiene. •     Apply container security practices including image provenance, least-privilege runtime configuration and registry management. Cybersecurity — NGFW and WAF •     Deploy, configure and manage next-generation firewalls, including policy design, application control, IPS/IDS, URL filtering, TLS inspection and threat prevention profiles. •     Deploy and tune web application firewalls, including rule sets, policy exceptions, false-positive tuning and protection of published client applications. •     Implement network segmentation and zero-trust-aligned access policies across client environments. •     Support CORE’s CNSsecure security offerings and integrate deployed controls with client monitoring and reporting. •     Investigate security events, analyze firewall and system logs, and produce clear post-incident findings for clients. •     Stay current with emerging threats, vendor advisories and firmware and security patching cycles across managed platforms. Hypervisor Deployment & Management •     Design, deploy and manage virtualization platforms including Proxmox VE, Microsoft Hyper-V and Morpheus. •     Build and maintain clustered hypervisor environments including shared storage, high availability and live migration. •     Manage virtual machine lifecycle: provisioning, templating, resource allocation, snapshots and capacity planning. •     Configure virtual networking, distributed switching and hypervisor-level segmentation. •     Integrate virtualization platforms with backup and recovery tooling, and regularly validate restore capability. •     Perform hypervisor upgrades, patching and migrations between platforms. Project Travel & On-Site Delivery •     Travel to client sites across Alberta, British Columbia and Western Canada to deliver network and infrastructure implementations — approximately 25% of working time, typically in multi-day blocks scheduled in advance. •     Perform physical installation work: rack and stack, structured cabling termination and dressing, device mounting, labelling and equipment decommissioning. Troubleshooting & Analysis •     Serve as the senior escalation point for complex, cross-domain issues spanning network, server, virtualization and security layers. •     Apply a structured diagnostic method — reproduce, isolate the fault domain, test hypotheses, confirm root cause, remediate — rather than trial-and-error changes. •     Use packet capture and protocol analysis, log correlation and performance monitoring tooling to resolve issues others could not. •     Document root cause analyses and feed findings back into standards, monitoring and preventative maintenance. •     Mentor intermediate and junior technical staff in diagnostic technique and escalation discipline. Client Service & Managed Services Delivery •     Meet service level commitments and communicate proactively when timelines or scope change. •     Communicate directly with client technical and non-technical stakeholders •     Maintain client documentation to CORE standards •     Contribute to scoping, estimating and technical review of proposals and statements of work. •     Participate in the on-call rotation and after-hours maintenance windows as scheduled. Qualifications Required •     6–10+ years of progressive experience in network and infrastructure engineering, ideally including time with a managed services provider, VAR or multi-client consulting firm. •     Demonstrated experience leading network implementation projects end to end, on client sites. •     Strong hands-on enterprise routing and switching expertise, including VLANs, spanning tree, dynamic routing protocols and WAN/SD-WAN technologies. •     Solid Linux administration skills at the command line, including services, scripting, hardening and diagnostics. •     Practical Docker and container administration experience in a production context. •     Hands-on next-generation firewall experience — policy design, threat prevention, VPN and troubleshooting — plus working knowledge of web application firewalls. •     Hypervisor deployment and management experience with at least two of Proxmox VE, Hyper-V or Morpheus, and the capacity to become proficient in all three. •     Excellent troubleshooting and analytical ability across multiple technology layers. •     Strong written and verbal communication in English, including client-facing documentation. •     Valid Class 5 driver’s licence and a reliable vehicle for local and regional travel. •     Ability to pass criminal record and security clearance checks required by public-sector and health-sector clients. •     Legally entitled to work in Canada. Preferred •     Experience serving Canadian public-sector or health-sector clients (municipal, county, health authority). •     Familiarity with CORE’s primary vendor lines: Check Point, Fortinet, Juniper, HPE, Arista, Lenovo and Microsoft. •     Backup and disaster recovery experience, particularly where Canadian data residency is required. •     Infrastructure-as-code, configuration management or CI/CD exposure (Ansible, Terraform, Git-based workflows). •     Monitoring and observability tooling experience. •     Microsoft 365 and Entra ID / Active Directory administration. •     Experience mentoring or leading a small technical team. Certifications Certifications are valued, but demonstrated capability matters more. Any of the following are considered assets, and CORE supports certification pursuit for the right candidate. •     Security: Check Point CCSA / CCSE, Fortinet NSE 4–7, CompTIA Security+, SSCP •     Networking: Juniper JNCIA / JNCIS, JNCIP, JNCIE,Cisco CCNA / CCNP, CCIE, HPE Aruba ACSA / ACSP •     Linux: LPIC-1 / LPIC-2, Red Hat RHCSA / RHCE, CompTIA Linux+ •     Virtualization: Proxmox VE certification, Microsoft AZ-800 / AZ-801, VMware VCP •     Containers: Docker Certified Associate, Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) Working Conditions •     Based at CORE’s Prince George, BC office, with a mix of office, client-site and remote work. •     Approximately 25% travel, primarily within Alberta and British Columbia, including occasional overnight and multi-day trips to rural and remote client sites. Travel is scheduled in advance wherever possible. •     Scheduled after-hours and weekend maintenance windows are a normal part of infrastructure cutover work. •     Participation in an on-call rotation. •     Physical requirements include lifting and positioning equipment up to approximately 50 lbs, working in server rooms and equipment closets. Core Network Solutions Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome and encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to providing accommodation for applicants with disabilities throughout the recruitment process — please let us know if you require accommodation.

If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase. As an Infrastructure Lead on the Exchange team within Institutional, you'll own the network infrastructure, deployment, and operational tooling behind a unified trading platform that runs across cloud and on-prem/colocated venues. This team powers the systems that let the world's largest financial institutions trade across markets with speed, depth, and trust. You'll keep latency-sensitive, multi-node trading environments fast, reliable, and easy to build on, shaping trading infrastructure from the ground up with the ownership of a startup and the reach of Coinbase. What you'll do: Own, operate, and optimize resilient, ultra-low-latency networks and physical data-center infrastructure supporting institutional trading, market data, and exchange connectivity across cloud and on-prem environments, including racking, cabling, cross-connects, and vendor coordination. Design and maintain routing, traffic-segmentation, and multicast market-data architectures using BGP, OSPF, VRFs, PIM, IGMP, and high-availability platforms such as Arista MLAG, Cisco vPC, and VRRP. Deploy and operate firewalls and secure connectivity across Fortinet and Palo Alto platforms, including IPsec VPNs, SSL VPNs, and third-party connections. Drive observability and operational excellence through SNMP, gRPC telemetry, latency and packet-loss analysis, microburst detection, and network automation using Python, Ansible, or similar tools. Lead safe production changes, incident response, failover testing, and out-of-hours maintenance for 24/7 trading systems, and participate in an on-call rotation. Mentor engineers and partner cross-functionally with SRE/Infra, Product, and trading-system teams to improve reliability, reduce single-point-of-failure risk, and increase developer velocity. Required Skills and Experience: 8+ years of network, infrastructure, or SRE engineering experience with demonstrated ownership of production systems in financial services, electronic trading, or another latency-sensitive environment, including on-prem/colocated deployments. Deep hands-on expertise with multicast networking, BGP, OSPF, VRFs, high-availability architectures, low-latency data-center switching, and physical network infrastructure. Proven ability to lead live incident response for production trading systems, manage risk during changes, and coordinate cross-functional resolution during market events. Experience with Fortinet or Palo Alto firewalls, VPNs, SNMP or gRPC telemetry, network automation using Python or Ansible, and strong Linux networking fundamentals in latency-critical environments. Familiarity with exchange or electronic trading system concepts; deep crypto experience is a plus, not a requirement. Utilizes generative AI responsibly, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.
